name: Interactive RBF Reconstruction via Volume Slicing
definition: A visualization approach that eliminates storing volume data in 3D textures, instead using the GPU fragment processor to perform on-the-fly reconstruction of RBF-encoded volumetric data during the rasterization of each slice.
summary: Interactive RBF Reconstruction via Volume Slicing renders volumetric data by procedurally computing RBF values per fragment on the GPU, eliminating 3D texture storage needs.
